summary.overview: The project's strongest harness assets - a 171-method contract and regression suite plus frozen-registry integrity - do not reach the currently changed optimizer chain: its result artifacts disagree, the documented run overwrites a tracked document, and latent defects sit in staged code that no check would catch. No Qoder session evidence is observable on this machine, so agent work-loop behavior is unobserved and this review is session-limited.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: progress.md provides a file-role map and documented run commands, but no AGENTS.md routes an agent, the narrative already drifts from the artifacts it describes, and the current diff mixes bulk data churn with core logic edits.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Setup and run commands are documented (Python 3.13, pip install pytest tzdata), but there is no manifest, doctor route, or managed output boundary - the documented optimizer run overwrites a tracked findings document.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: A dense 171-method contract and regression suite covers the EA and TRIAD chains with token-named failures, but nothing maps the currently changed optimizer chain; defects in this very diff confirm the gap.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Acceptance is narrative: staged progress notes, regenerated findings, and validation comments disagree on the champion result, no CI or merge gate exists, and recovery relies on git alone.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: A bounded review was completed, but no Qoder session evidence is observable on this machine and the project owns no memory or skill assets, so no repeated-work or learning claim is decidable.

findings.title: A regression in the changed optimizer tools passes the entire test suite
findings.reason: The current diff rewrites the data loader in tools/aggressive_optimizer.py, adds the 802-line tools/strategy_optimizer.py, and adds tools/_validate_4yr.py, but none of the 171 test methods under tests/ import any of these modules (verified by import map). The suite is the project's declared validation route - progress.md documents the 171 tests and the evidence pack routes validation through tests/ - so a load_pair regression (wrong CSV picked, or silently loading no data) passes every check; the defects sitting in this same diff show the gap is live. Owner: tests/ has no focused coverage for the changed chain. Uncertainty: the changed scripts declare no test requirement of their own, so this is a wiring gap between existing validation and the changed entrypoint, not an execution failure.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Test owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add the smallest focused pytest coverage for the changed optimizer chain in tests/, following the existing contract-test style of tests/test_source_contract.py: loader behavior of tools/aggressive_optimizer.py (including the no-match and multi-match paths of load_pair) and the write path of tools/strategy_optimizer.py.

## Validation

- Run the focused tests and confirm a deliberately wrong loader pick fails a named test

findings.title: Result artifacts disagree on the champion strategy and its numbers
findings.reason: Three co-changed artifacts in the current diff state different results for the same revalidation: staged progress.md says the best config is RB=8 with Phase 1 in 15 days and GBPJPY $4,509; the regenerated findings_aggressive_optimizer.md says the best is RB=6 with Phase 1 in 8 days (its RB=8 row is number 5 at 12 days) and GBPJPY $5,789; tools/_validate_4yr.py's own comment says 12 days. Nothing in the repo reconciles them, and which numbers are correct cannot be decided without a run (nothing was executed in this review). Consequence: any future task that trusts the repo's narrative may select or trade the wrong configuration. Owners: progress.md, findings_aggressive_optimizer.md, and tools/_validate_4yr.py each record results independently. Uncertainty: the inconsistency is statically verified; adjudicating the correct numbers requires running the pipeline.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Document owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Make one authoritative source for the revalidation result: re-run the documented pipeline (python tools/aggressive_optimizer.py), then update progress.md, findings_aggressive_optimizer.md, and the tools/_validate_4yr.py comments to the same best-config and headline numbers, or clearly mark the superseded ones.

## Validation

- The three artifacts state the same best config, Phase-1 duration, and GBPJPY figure, or explicitly mark the stale values as superseded

findings.title: Each optimizer run overwrites the tracked findings document and its bug writeups
findings.reason: write_findings in tools/aggressive_optimizer.py writes directly to the tracked findings_aggressive_optimizer.md. The current diff shows the consequence: a regeneration removed 169 lines of curated bug writeups while the staged progress.md still references that content. The project already gitignores its other generated validation outputs (validation/*.csv, *_report.json), so a managed-output convention exists; this document is the one generated report written into a tracked path, and recovery is only through git. Owner: the output path choice in tools/aggressive_optimizer.py plus the repo's ignore conventions. Uncertainty: whether this particular regeneration was intended; the destructive output contract itself is static and observed.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Code owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Route the optimizer's generated findings to a gitignored output path consistent with the existing validation-output ignores, or preserve the curated sections when regenerating, and update progress.md references to the new location.

## Validation

- Running the documented optimizer command no longer modifies a tracked findings_*.md file, and the referenced bug writeups remain available

findings.title: Staged strategy_optimizer.py crashes its findings output on any viable run
findings.reason: Line 716 of the staged tools/strategy_optimizer.py uses an invalid f-string format spec (a ':.2f if ... else ...' expression inside the spec), which raises ValueError whenever write_findings formats a win-rate line; the correct conditional form is already used at line 554 of the same file. The path is currently inert because the tick CSVs named in TICK_FILES are absent from the repo (verified), and the staged progress.md labels the file as superseded and committed for history, so the defect is present in staged code but has not fired. Deterministic static defect; runtime was not executed in this review.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Code owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:

Fix the invalid f-string format spec at line 716 of tools/strategy_optimizer.py to match the correct conditional form already used at line 554 of the same file.

## Validation

findings.title: Regenerated findings report the wrong data window for the current dataset
findings.reason: write_findings in tools/aggressive_optimizer.py hardcodes a header claiming roughly Jan 2024 to Sep 2026, about 2.5 years and 200K bars per pair, but the rewritten loader now selects the 2022-09-11 to 2026-09-11 four-year files (about 289K rows per pair). Every result in the regenerated findings_aggressive_optimizer.md is therefore presented under a false evidence basis, which matters in a repository whose purpose is validating a trading strategy over a specific window. Owner: the hardcoded template line. Uncertainty: low - both the template and the selected data files were opened.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Code owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Derive the data-window header in write_findings from the files actually loaded (span and row count) instead of the hardcoded string.

## Validation

- The regenerated findings state the actual loaded span and bar count, matching the selected CSV filenames

findings.title: No observable Qoder session evidence leaves repeated-work learning undecidable
findings.reason: The production session source probe checked the six enabled Qoder source roots for this workspace and found that 0 of 6 exist (audit log, run manifests, log sessions, project sessions, and home sessions; two further roots are disabled). The 30-day window therefore admits 0 eligible sessions and 0 Task Episodes, so this and future harness reviews on this machine cannot distinguish repeated work, validation habits, or memory value, and must stay session-limited. The cause is not established by the evidence - absent roots could reflect where this Qoder install stores its data, retention, or teardown, not a project defect. Per the review model, this unresolved observation boundary requires an explicit evidence-gap record instead of a no-activity claim.
